title: hieracium integrifolium subsp. obscuratum
intro:
Hieracium integrifolium subsp. obscuratum, commonly known as the Rough Hawk's Beard, is a flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae) known for its distinctive, rough-haired leaves and stems.

The health benefits of Hieracium integrifolium subsp. obscuratum include its potential use in treating digestive issues and its ability to support the immune system, although more research is needed to confirm its effectiveness.

The therapeutic actions of this plant are believed to be due to its bioactive constituents, which may exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its potential to stimulate the digestive system.

The bioactive constituents of Hieracium integrifolium subsp. obscuratum include flavonoids, terpenoids, and other compounds, although a more comprehensive analysis of its chemical composition is required to fully understand its potential therapeutic applications.
